spans.s:
r. 5th cl. but restricted to the Vedas (जिरिणोति)
To injure, wound or kill.

m. (-रः)
1 Cumin seed.
2 A sacrificial knife or sword, a scymitar.
3 A sort of panic seed: see अणु.
E.
जु to go, or grow quickly, रक् Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel changed.

m. (-कः)
Cumin seed.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Old, ancient.
2 Withered, decayed.
3 Digested.
m. (-र्णः)
1 An old man.
2 Cumin seed.
n. (-र्णं)
Benjamin.
E.
जॄ to become old or decayed, affix क्त.

m. (-रः)
Fever of some continuance and diminished intensity.
E.
जीर्ण, and ज्वर fever.

f. (-ता)
1 Old age.
2 Infirmity, decay.
E.
जीर्ण, and तल् affix; also with त्व, जीर्णत्वं.

m. (-रुः)
A potherb, (Convolvulus argentaceus.)
E.
जीर्ण, and दारु wood.

m. (-र्णः)
The Kadamba: see कदम्बक.
n. (-र्णं)
A withered leaf.
E.
जीर्ण old, withered, and पर्ण a leaf.

n. (-ज्रं)
A gem, said to be a sort of diamond.
E.
जीर्ण decayed, वज्र diamond.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Old, decayed.
E.
जॄ to grow old, क्तवतु aff.

n. (-स्रं)
Old, worn or tattered raiment.
E.
जीर्ण old, and वस्त्र cloth or clothes.

f. (-का)
A ruined mansion.
E.
जीर्ण, and वाटिका a house.

m. (-कः)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
जीर्ण old, and व्रध्न a root, affix कन्.

f. (-र्णिः)
1 Old age, infirmity, decay.
2 Digestion.
E.
जॄ to become old, क्तिन् aff.

n. (-नं)
A neglected garden.
E.
जीर्ण, and उद्यान a garden.

m. (-रः)
Repairing, renewal, repairs.
E.
जीर्ण, and उद्धार lifting up.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Repaired, renewed.
E.
जीर्ण, and उद्धृत lifted up.

m. (-र्विः)
1 An axe.
2 A cart.
3 The body.
E.
जॄ to decay, Uṇādi affix क्विन्.
